findings.title: A trait method's `effects Ret=0` is believed at `dyn` call sites although no impl is ever checked against it: a view into a dead frame is accepted and the generated C reads freed stack (ASAN stack-use-after-scope)
findings.why: parseTrait parses every method with p->noBody set, i.e. down the `extern!` path of parseFunc, whose noBody branch (parser.c:1614-1619) accepts an `effects` clause after the signature. So a trait method -- which has no body and no call site of its own -- can carry `effects Ret=0`, and the clause is stored on the trait's FuncDef. Nothing ever compares that clause with the implementations: the conformance pass checks method names (check_top.c:5333-5342) and resolved parameter/return types, never hasEffects/extRetFresh. But a `dyn Trait` call resolves to the TRAIT's FuncDef (`e->func = want;`, check_expr.c:3467), and the escape analysis answers "this reference does not point into the caller's frames" from exactly that FuncDef (`return e->func && e->func->extRetFresh;`, check_escape.c:114). An impl that returns a view into the caller's storage therefore inherits the trait's freshness promise, and a binding initialized from the dyn call is marked outOfFrame (check_stmt.c:470-479), so a pointer that dies with the frame is accepted into a global. The clause is not an `extern!`-style signature over a black box: the impls are in the same program and are checked by this compiler, so believing one declaration's clause about another declaration's body is the hole.
findings.trigger: A trait whose method declares `effects Ret=0` and returns a reference or a view (`slice<T>`, `ref T`, `?ref T`), implemented by an impl that returns a view into the caller's storage; the method is called through a `dyn` value and the result (or `.data`) is stored where the pointed-at local is already dead. The same program with a concrete receiver is rejected, and the same program without `effects Ret=0` in the trait is rejected -- the dyn path is the only thing that reads the clause.

findings.title: 全局声明（let/var）上的 `@noCopy` / `@poolObject` / `@sharesStorage` / `@inline` 被静默接受且完全不做任何事
findings.why: 顶层注解循环（parser.c:499-604）自己写下的规则是：注解是对编译器的指令，被忽略的注解必须报错，否则写的人会以为要求生效了。`let`/`var` 分支只拒了 `@export` / `@frozen` / `@unchecked` 三个，`@noCopy` / `@poolObject` / `@sharesStorage` / `@inline` 四个既不生效也不报错；而同一批注解在 `struct`（`@noCopy`/`@poolObject`/`@sharesStorage` 有效）、`impl`/`trait`/`type`（全部拒）上都有明确归宿。
findings.trigger: 任何把 `@noCopy`、`@poolObject`、`@sharesStorage`、`@inline` 写在顶层 `let`/`var` 上的程序。
findings.repro:
printf '@noCopy
var g: i32 = 0
fn main() -> i32 { return 0 }
' > g.extc; ./build/extc -w g.extc -o /dev/null   # 退出码 0，无任何诊断；换成 @poolObject/@sharesStorage/@inline 同样。对照：@unchecked / @frozen / @export 在同样的位置会被正确拒绝。

findings.title: Top-level annotations that do not apply to the declaration that follows are silently dropped (except on `let`/`var`, already reported): `@inline`/`@builtin` on struct and enum, `@noCopy`/`@poolObject`/`@sharesStorage`/`@builtin` on fn and `extern!`
findings.why: The dispatch after the annotation loop (parser.c:606-834) checks each flag against only some declaration kinds; every flag it does not check is accepted and thrown away. Concretely: `fnInline` is checked by `impl` (637), `trait` (651) and `extern!` (755) but not by `struct` (606) or `type` (663); `builtinDecl` is read only by the `fn` branch (795) and never checked by `struct`, `impl`, `trait`, `type` or `extern!`; `noCopy`/`poolObject`/`sharesStorage` are checked by `type` (671-689), `impl` (637) and `trait` (651) but not by `fn` (777) or `extern!` (735). That contradicts the rule stated just above the annotation loop: "Any other annotation is an error: these are instructions to the compiler, and one that is ignored would leave the reader believing something was asked for that never happened" (parser.c:499-501). The reader of `@builtin struct bi { ... }` is told the compiler supplies the declaration, and of `@noCopy extern! fn getpid()` that the C symbol may not be copied; neither is true and nothing says so. (The `let`/`var` half of the same defect is the Lead's finding at line 708; this one covers the remaining declaration kinds.)
findings.trigger: Any of these spellings, each accepted with no diagnostic: `@inline struct`, `@inline type`, `@builtin struct`, `@builtin impl`, `@builtin trait`, `@builtin extern!`, `@noCopy fn`, `@noCopy extern!`, `@sharesStorage fn`, `@poolObject fn`.

findings.title: parseTrait throws away the method's own type-parameter list (`fn f<T>` in a trait), so the signature later fails with a misleading `unknown type T`
findings.why: parseFunc has already parsed the method's own `<...>` into m->typeParams (parser.c:1569-1583; for generic methods that list is real -- an `impl` method `fn f<T>(self: ref s, x: T)` compiles and works). parseTrait then re-initializes that Vec, discarding the parsed parameters, and fills it with `Self` plus the trait's parameters only. The signature keeps mentioning `T`, so resolveSignature (check_top.c:5534-5536 walks td->methods) fails with "unknown type `T`" pointing at the trait's method line. The declaration was accepted by the grammar and mangled in silence; either generic trait methods should be supported, or the parser should reject `fn f<T>` in a trait body with a message that says so.
findings.trigger: Any trait method that declares its own type parameters: `trait C { fn f<T>(self: ref Self, v: T) -> i64; }`.

findings.title: 重复注解的检查不一致：`@inline @inline` 与 `@noCopy @noCopy` 静默通过，`@frozen @frozen` 报错
findings.why: `@private`(506-511)、`@export`(522-526)、`@unchecked`(534-540)、`@frozen`(569-576) 都有“说了两遍”检查并报错；`@inline`(515)、`@noCopy`(544)、`@poolObject`(553)、`@sharesStorage`(561)、`@builtin`(578) 只置位不查重。同一层语法里两套规矩，用户无法预期。

findings.title: `parseEffectsClause` 末尾有不可达的第二个 `return true;`
findings.why: 395 行已经 return，396 行永远不执行；函数还带着 `p->ctx` 未使用的形参语义。属死代码。

findings.title: `pk()` 在令牌向量为空时下标下溢（`p->toks->len - 1` 变成 SIZE_MAX）
findings.code_quote:
size_t i = p->pos + k;
    if (i >= p->toks->len) i = p->toks->len - 1;    /* clamp at EOF */
findings.why: `toks->len == 0` 时 `len - 1` 是 size_t 下溢，`vecAt` 会按 SIZE_MAX 偏移读内存。今天 `lexAll` 保证至少压入一个 TK_EOF，所以不可达；但这是“调用方必须保证非空”的隐含前提，没有任何断言或注释。
findings.trigger: 任何让 `parseModule` 收到空 token 向量的未来调用方（例如新增一个只做 parse 的入口）。
findings.repro: 无（不可达）。静态依据：src/lexer.c 的 lexAll 末尾无条件 push TK_EOF。

findings.title: 顶层 `fn` 分支里的 `|| at(&p, "@")` 与随后的 `parseFuncAnnotations` 是不可达死路径
findings.why: 从 502 行开始的注解循环在遇到 `@` 时要么消费并置位，要么报错返回；走到 777 行时游标不可能还在 `@` 上。于是 `at(&p, "@")` 永远为假，787 行的第二次 `parseFuncAnnotations`（以及 `inl`/`unchk` 的二次读取）没有任何输入能到达——同一份逻辑写了两遍，改一处不会影响另一处。
findings.repro: 读 parser.c:502-605（注解循环）与 777-800（fn 分支）即可判定；`@inline fn f(){}` 走的是 502 行那一遍。

findings.title: trait 的类型参数不要求大写，与 struct 的检查不一致
findings.why: `struct`（863-869 行）要求类型参数首字母大写并给出理由（避免与类型名相撞）；`trait`（1058-1075）与 `impl`（1129-1146）只检查 kind。同一种语法位置三套规矩。
findings.repro: printf 'trait t<x> { fn f(self: ref x) -> i32 }\nfn main() -> i32 { return 0 }\n' > tt.extc; ./build/extc -w tt.extc -o /dev/null   # rc=0

findings.title: shown() assumes TK_NEWLINE has empty text, but the lexer stores "\n": diagnostics print a raw newline inside the backticks
findings.why: The comment above (parser.c:104-105) states "A token with empty text (TK_EOF, TK_NEWLINE) shows its kind name instead, so a message never ends in `found ""`". Only TK_EOF has empty text: lexAll pushes TK_NEWLINE with text "\n" (lexer.c:509 and :542), so t->text[0] is non-zero and the fallback never fires for newlines. Every "found `%s`" in the parser can therefore emit a message with a literal newline in it, splitting the diagnostic across two lines (and the note/caret lines no longer line up with it). The claim in the comment is what hides the bug.
findings.trigger: Any syntax error whose cursor lands on a newline, e.g. a field whose type was left off at end of line, or an import list or annotation list broken across lines.
findings.repro:
printf 'struct s {\n    x:\n}\nfn main() -> i32 { return 0 }\n' > /tmp/t_nl.extc
./build/extc /tmp/t_nl.extc -o /dev/null; echo exit=$?
# observed:
#   t_nl.extc:2:7: error: expected a type, found `
#   `
#       x:
#         ^
# (the offending token is rendered as a literal line break instead of `NEWLINE`)

coverage_notes:
Lead 亲读（原定审阅单元未交付）。逐行读完 src/parser.c 1-1220：lookahead 工具（pk/cur/at/atKind/take/accept/shown/expect/expectIdent/skipNl/skipJunk，1-158）、parseUse（245-318）、parseEffectsClause（342-397）、parseExtern（399-456）、parseModule 顶层循环与注解循环（471-838）、parseStruct（845-969）、parseDottedName（998-1017）、parseTrait（1034-1107）、parseImpl（1109-1230 起）。已核实为正确/合理的点：`pk` 对 EOF 的钳位让所有定长前瞻无越界；`take` 不会越过 TK_EOF；`at()` 对字符串字面量与标点的区分（lexIsPunct）；`expectIdent`/`expect` 的报错路径都返回后由调用方立即 return；`parseUse` 的 `::*` 与 `::{a,b}` 分支互斥且报错位置正确；`parseStruct` 对 `@inline`/`@unchecked` 落在字段上的拒绝；`parseTrait` 用 p->noBody 复用 extern 路径且把 Self 作为首个类型参数；`parseImpl` 对 `leadArgs` 先收集后归档（有无 for 两种语义）与三处 vecInit 的先后（注释里记着一次真实踩坑）。未覆盖：1221 之后（由 parser-2/parser-3 单元覆盖）。 另：本次复核确认了两条已由别的单元报告的缺陷（`effects` 续接判断漏 `Ret`，parser.c:392；`extThreadMask` 保守缺省只在子句内设置，parser.c:345），为避免重复计数未列入 findings。

===== parser-1 独立复核单元（src/parser.c 第 1-1220 行，2026-09-30，与上面的 Lead 亲读合并）=====
逐行读完 1-1220，并在需要判定被调用方行为时读了单元外：startsUpper/expectTypeName(1333-1356)、parseFuncAnnotations(1451-1552)、parseFunc 的签名/noBody/effects 段(1554-1645)、lexer.c 的 lexAll/lexIsPunct/lexChar、collectEffects(check_top.c:2733-2767)、dyn 调用解析(check_expr.c:3380-3470)、exprOutOfFrame(check_escape.c:79-116)、checkStoreEscape/check_stmt.c:440-500。
本单元函数清单：pk/cur/at/atKind/take/accept/shown/expect/expectIdent/skipNl/skipJunk、mkBin/isScalarTypeName、parseUse、parseEffectsClause、parseExtern、parseModule（顶层分派 + 注解循环）、parseStruct、parseDottedName、parseTrait、parseImpl(到 1220)。
已核实为正确的点（查过、未报）：pk 的 len-1 钳位因 lexAll 必压 TK_EOF 而安全(lexer.c:538-543)；本单元每处 vecPush 之前都有非 NULL arena 的 vecInit（1121-1123 注释警告的那个坑已处理）；重复字段/重复方法由 checker 报错；parseImpl 的 leadArgs/traitArgs/typeArgs 归位对 `impl Trait<A> for T` / `impl<T> Trait<T> for T<U>` / `impl<T> pair<T>` 三种写法都正确；parseDottedName 首段接受 TK_TYPE（`impl i64` 可用）；`use a::{}` 与尾逗号不会死循环；字符字面量是 TK_INT 且 text 带引号，不会与标点/标识符混淆。
未确认/未追：`use a::{}`（空名字列表）看起来会静默退化成 `use a`（modules.c:2029 在 names.len==0 时跳过名字列表那一路），未做端到端验证故未列为 finding；重复类型参数（`struct pair<T,T>`）被接受、布局取第一个绑定而修饰名含两个实参（`pair<i64,u8>` 的 a 是 i64），属无意义输入、危害未证明，故不报。
对已知项的补充证据（不新增条目）：trait 类型参数不大写（Lead 的 1058 条目）在 trait 里能真实遮蔽同名类型——`struct point{x:i64}` + `trait C<point>{ fn f(self: ref Self, v: point)->i64 }` + `impl C<i64> for s{...v: i64...}` 编译通过(exit 0)，即签名里的 `point` 被解析成 trait 参数并被 `i64` 兑现；impl 那一路（1129-1146 同样缺 startsUpper）随后会被 checker 的“类型参数名必须与声明一致”挡住(check_top.c:5400-5405)。
单元外相邻观察（交给 1221-3649 的审阅者，不计入本单元 findings）：parser.c:1635 只用 `if (fd->extAddrMask || fd->extContMask)` 拒绝有函数体时的 `Addr`/`Cont`，所以 `fn f(self: ref s) -> i64 effects Addr=0 { ... }`（Cont=0 同理）会作为空操作被接受（实测 exit 0），与注释“body already says what it stores”不符。
